chunks: And Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: Can a woman lead women? He said: “No, except over the deceased, if there is no one more entitled than her. She stands in their midst with them in the row, then she pronounces the takbir and they pronounce takbir.”

key_terms.أَوْلَى: more entitled or more appropriate to take precedence
key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: the women being led in prayer
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being asked about as a possible prayer leader
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed
key_terms.تَؤُمُّ: leads in prayer as the imam
key_terms.فَتُكَبِّرُ: she pronounces the takbir in the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Can a woman lead other women in prayer according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a woman leading other women in prayer. It states that she does not lead them in regular salat, but she may lead the funeral prayer over the deceased when no one more entitled than her is present, standing among them in the row.
